content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: on the cap / floor screen, clicking Save shows an overlay and then a visible error, and after the user dismisses it with OK the user returns to the Notional field, edits it, and clicks Save again, which repeats in each Save cycle within session S6baba239.", "fix": "Fix: On the cap / floor screen, change the Save click handler so that a validation failure shows its message inline next to the Notional input and moves focus to that input, instead of a blocking overlay that must be dismissed with OK before the field can be corrected.", "cited_event_ids": ["315", "316:w336", "app:36", "328", "336", "340", "362", "app:43", "383", "387", "407", "app:50"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The error event records only 'visible' with no message text, so the actual validation rule and the field it refers to are not shown.", "Whether the blocking overlay is an error dialog or another overlay is not stated; only 'overlay shown' and 'overlay removed' are recorded.", "The events do not show that Notional is the field that fails validation; the link to Notional comes only from the repeated Notional re-entry after each error.", "The Trade Date and Counterparty errors (ids 64:a66 and 281:a299) occur before Save and are not analysed here.", "Only one session's window is provided, so the pattern across the three affected sessions cannot be checked."]}
